definitions.explanation: Any dish in which eggs are the main ingredient. Encompasses a wide range of preparations across cuisines, from simple fried eggs to elaborate dishes like chawanmushi.

examples.japanese: {卵料理|たまごりょうり}は{手軽|てがる}に{作|つく}れる。
examples.english: Egg dishes are easy to make.

examples.japanese: この{店|みせ}は{卵料理|たまごりょうり}が{豊富|ほうふ}でオムライスが{特|とく}に{人気|にんき}だ。
examples.english: This restaurant has a rich selection of egg dishes, with omurice being especially popular.

examples.japanese: {卵|たまご}アレルギーがあるので、{卵料理|たまごりょうり}は{食|た}べられない。
examples.english: I have an egg allergy, so I can't eat egg dishes.

notes:
A compound of {卵|たまご} (egg) and {料理|りょうり} (cooking, dish). A commonly used culinary category term.

COMMON JAPANESE EGG DISHES:
- {卵焼|たまごや}き — rolled omelet (a staple in bento boxes)
- {茶碗蒸|ちゃわんむ}し — savory steamed egg custard
- オムライス — rice wrapped in a thin omelet
- {目玉焼|めだまや}き — fried egg (sunny-side up)
- {親子丼|おやこどん} — chicken and egg rice bowl
- {卵|たまご}かけご{飯|はん} (TKG) — raw egg mixed into hot rice

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {卵料理|たまごりょうり}を{作|つく}る — to make an egg dish
- {簡単|かんたん}な{卵料理|たまごりょうり} — a simple egg dish
- {卵料理|たまごりょうり}のレシピ — egg dish recipes

RELATED WORDS:
- {卵|たまご} — egg
- {生卵|なまたまご} — raw egg
- {半熟卵|はんじゅくたまご} — soft-boiled egg
- ゆで{卵|たまご} — boiled egg
